items.name: Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025

venue.name: The Gigiri Court Yard
venue.address: Gigiri Lane, Gigiri

items.information:
**NOTE: THIS EVENT IS A SERIES COMPETITION.** 

**Each participant can only compete in one of the two competitions.**

Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025, and Gigiri Cubing Open PM 2025 are recognized as WCA series competitions.
WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in only one of them.
If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be considered valid.

The payment of 800ksh will be collected on the day of the competition at the registration desk. MPESA will also be accepted.

This page is for Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025.
　[Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GigiriCubingOpenAM2025) (AM - Morning Session) - (From 8:30am to 12:30pm)
　[Gigiri Cubing Open PM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GigiriCubingOpenPM2025) (PM - Afternoon Session) - (From 1:30pm to 5:30pm)

The registration timings for each event are as follows:
　AM : Begins at 8:30am. Closes at 9:00am
　PM : Begins at 1:30pm. Closes at 2:00pm

The New Competitor's tutorial will be held at 8:45 for AM, and 13:45 for PM. If this is your first competition, do be on time for the competitor's tutorial.

Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality.

Photos and videos are taken in the venue.

Please be familiar with the WCA Regulations, found here:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/

items.name: Hike 2 Cube Kenya 2023

venue.name: Ol Donyo Sabuk (Mt Kilimambogo)
venue.address: Ol Donyo Sabuk, Machakos, Kenya

items.information:
Welcome! This will be the world's first ever WCA competition on top of a mountain!

Please go through each and every tab for all the information about this trip, and let the organiser know about any specific quiries you may have.

We will be hiking to the top of Ol Donyo Sabuk (Mt Kilimambogo). It is going to be a 9 kilometer walk to the top, and another 9 to come back down...

This competition is recommended for only competitors aged 12 and above. Those who are aged younger may have difficulties walking long distances.

It will be a road trip from the capital, Nairobi, to the venue in Machakos, and back. 

Competitors also have the option to drive up the mountain (provided they have their own personal vehicles) incase they are not in a position to hike. Make sure to inform the organiser in advance if this will be the case.

venue.name: Peponi House Preparatory School
venue.address: Peponi House Preparatory School, Farasi Lane, Nairobi, Kenya

items.information:
Welcome to the third WCA competition in Kenya! 
This competition is specifically created for those who are aged 13 and under. Those who are aged 14 and above can participate... but will not qualify to get a prize on the podium.

Participants should bring some form of identification in order to confirm that they are aged 13 and below. A passport, or a copy of your birth cirtificate is a good example since it shows name, age, nationality and so on.  

You only need to be present at the venue during the events in which you plan to attend. However, you need to be present at the venue no later than 15 minutes before your first event starts so that you have enough time to complete the registration.
